steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0008, t0011, t0012, t0067 dependencies are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure and step-tracker.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review existing project papers for BK/SK/Kv7 kinetic models, RGC channel literature, and tuning-width metric conventions.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for published BK/SK/Kv7 MOD source models (ModelDB), RGC-specific kinetic parameter sets, and per-channel reference biological densities.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0067 channel-addition layer, t0008 Bed A init_active and HHst configuration, t0024 Bed B `cad` calcium-pool mechanism, t0011 visualisation library, and t0012 tuning-curve loss library.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesise research outputs into the implementation plan: vendoring sources for BK/SK/Kv7 + calcium pool, regression-gate definition (DSI = 0.797 +/- 1e-3), 25-condition sweep design, passive-mode diagnostics, width-metric pipeline.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: task is local-CPU only per task description.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Vendor BK/SK/Kv7 MODs + calcium pool, un-zero CaL/CaT, run regression gate, run 1500 FULL + 600 passive-mode trials, compute width metrics, generate per-channel sensitivity plots.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis on alternative interpretations of inert-channel results and surprising tuning-width effects.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json with width-metric tables and per-channel sensitivity plots.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare measured BK/SK/Kv7 effects against published RGC and DSGC channel literature; identify expected vs surprising findings.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up task suggestions from results and literature comparison.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all relevant verificators, capture sessions, set task status to completed.
